invocation.prompt: Implement the source-controlled task bnw-filter-demo-001 in this BraveNewWorld checkout. The base is BNW-0. Build a complete deterministic noisy-sine and first-order low-pass teaching demo while preserving the existing first-order-step behavior. Use only the Python standard library and local HTML/CSS/JavaScript; do not change dependencies, AGENTS.md, the bnw launcher, pyproject.toml, Git configuration, branches, commits, remotes, or files outside the allowed paths. Interactive and headless execution must call the same simulation kernel. Define a strict versioned request selected by demo_id, validate finite inputs and practical teaching bounds, use an explicitly implemented fixed integer-seed pseudo-random generator rather than global random state, and use a stable exact first-order low-pass discretization derived from cutoff frequency and dt. Return clean, noisy, and filtered samples plus raw RMS error, filtered RMS error, improvement percentage, theoretical magnitude attenuation in dB, theoretical phase lag in seconds, sample count, engine version, runtime version, and a deterministic trace hash. Add scenarios/noisy-low-pass.json and make ./bnw run-scenario dispatch it without breaking existing scenarios. Extend the loopback UI with a minimal clear demo selector and only controls, curves, legends, explanations, and metrics backed by the API. Add deterministic contract, numerical, CLI, and HTTP API tests. Update README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, and docs/DEVELOPMENT_LOG.md; add an ADR under docs/adr for durable signal/filter decisions. Run ./bnw check, fix all failures, inspect git diff for scope, and leave the verified working-tree changes uncommitted for JobSlayer to collect. Do not claim approval, merge, push, deployment, network isolation, or completion authority.
